name: Morning Light for Circadian Reset
equipment: Access to daylight, even through a window
instructions: Get outside or near a bright window within 30-60 minutes of waking tomorrow -- morning light is one of the strongest signals your body uses to set its sleep-wake clock.
Aim for at least 10 minutes of natural light exposure, even on a cloudy day (outdoor light is far brighter than indoor lighting).
Pair this with your consistent wake time from earlier in the program for the strongest circadian effect.
Close tonight with the guided deep sleep meditation as usual.
